mira-partnerships: partner (CloudAppliance) proposes switching from hourly exports to per-minute events. They sent sample payloads and want a 10-day migration window.

conrad-eng: can we ingest seconds and aggregate to minutes? yes. plan: accept both schemas for 21 days, feature flag new parser, canary limited to 8 devices. est 2 dev days + 1 infra day.

lee-devex: will provision sandbox + replay and publish golden-files. include sample curl and mapping CSV.

tara-legal: legal flag 1: need amendment for billing unit change, proration rules and customer notice. i'll draft.

ravi-sre: ops: require idempotency_key, add per-partner rate limiter, monitor dup-rate and ingestion p95. backfill must be throttled.

partner-bot: ACTION: ticket #PRT-3122 created assigned to conrad-eng (schema, sandbox, backfill, legal signoff).

mira-partnerships: action items: (1) conrad deploy plan by EOD, (2) lee sandbox + docs by tomorrow, (3) tara amendment draft, (4) ravi monitoring config. i'll ask partner for 30-day sample dump. :thumbsup:
